title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2146 on bicycles from China
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2146 of 22 October 2025 (OJ L 23.10.2025) imposes a definitive anti-dumping duty on bicycles originating in the People's Republic of China, as extended to bicycles consigned from several other countries, following an expiry review. Its recitals refer to the earlier extension of the measures to certain bicycle parts under Regulation (EC) No 71/97 and the related exemption scheme under Regulation (EC) No 88/97. No duty rate or classification is inferred here for a particular complete bike, frameset or buyer.
